title: Requirement (SWEBOK v4 ch. 1 + SEBoK — SP2)
description: A functional or non-functional requirement, elicited from the business model. An NFR MUST have a related quality scenario (Art. V).

level.description: SEBoK — a stakeholder need, or the system requirement that comes from it

traces_to.description: Art. IV — each requirement comes from a driver, concern, process, IDEF0 activity or need (BD-*, CON-*, BP-*, IDF-*, FR-*)

elicitation.description: SWEBOK v4 §1.2 — the technique and the sources of the elicitation

sources.description: The personas, stakeholders, processes or activities that were consulted (PER-*, STK-*, BP-*, IDF-*)

scenarios.description: The quality scenarios (QS-*). Mandatory if type=non-functional
